record.question: Hotspots of biodiversity were first identified by:
record.explanation: Answer A: Norman Myers. Norman Myers introduced the biodiversity-hotspot concept in 1988. Reference: https://www.conservation.org/priorities/biodiversity-hotspots. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
